title.ja: 図1-1 ひねり飛車の駒組み

explain.ja: 図1-1はひねり飛車の駒組みの一例です。居飛車の出だしから石田流三間飛車の形に組み直すのがポイントです。ひねり飛車の駒組みとして、縦歩取りの形と、棒銀を受けながらひねり飛車にする形の2つのパターンを紹介します。
explain.en: Diagram 1-1 is an example of the Twisting Rook (hineri-hisha) setup. The key is to switch from a Static Rook opening to an Ishida-style Third File Rook formation. Two patterns are shown: the tate-fu-tori form, and a form that parries Climbing Silver while going into Twisting Rook.

section.ja: ひねり飛車って?居飛車から石田流に組み替える
section.en: What is Twisting Rook? Switching from Static Rook to Ishida

title.ja: 図2-1 相掛かりの基本形
title.en: Figure 2-1: Basic form of Double Wing Attack

explain.ja: 図2-1は相掛かりの基本形です。ひねり飛車は相掛かりの形から石田流を目指す指し方なので、この形から解説します。
explain.en: Diagram 2-1 is the basic Aigakari form. Twisting Rook aims for Ishida from an Aigakari position, so we explain from this form.

title.en: Figure 2-2: Float the rook with ▲2六飛

explain.ja: 相掛かりの基本形から、▲2六飛と浮き飛車に構えます。この形から▲7六飛と石田流に組み替えるのを狙います。
explain.en: From the basic Aigakari form, set up a floating rook with ▲2六飛. The aim is to switch to Ishida with ▲7六飛 from here.

title.ja: 図2-3 将来は美濃囲いを目指す
title.en: Figure 2-3: Aim for Mino castle in the future

explain.ja: 浮き飛車に構えたら、▲3八銀としておきます。このまま石田流を目指す場合は、玉を右側に囲って美濃囲いを目指すので、3八の銀を守りに使います。ひねり飛車を諦めて居飛車で攻める場合は、3八の銀は攻めに使える位置です。この後の展開次第で、攻めにも守りにも使える銀です。
explain.en: Once the floating rook is set, play ▲3八銀. If you continue toward Ishida, the king castles on the right in a Mino castle and the silver on 3八 is used for defense. If you give up on Twisting Rook and attack as Static Rook, the silver on 3八 is in position to be used in the attack. It is a silver usable for either attack or defense, depending on later developments.

explain.ja: 石田流に組む前に、▲3六飛として相手の歩を狙います。この指し方は縦歩取りと呼ばれます。3四の歩を飛車の横利きで狙う横歩取りに対して、飛車の縦利きで歩を狙うので縦歩取りです。
explain.en: Before building Ishida, aim at the opponent's pawn with ▲3六飛. This is called tate-fu-tori. In contrast to Yokofudori, which targets the pawn on 3四 with the rook's sideways control, here the rook's vertical control targets the pawn.

section.en: Toward a Tate Fu Dori formation

title.ja: 図3-2 相手の陣形は悪形に
title.en: Figure 3-2: The opponent's formation becomes bad shape

explain.ja: 3四の歩を守るために相手は金を上げましたが、これで相手の角道が閉じ、金も玉の守りから離れてしまいました。縦歩取りは、△3三金を指させて相手の陣形を悪形にする狙いがあります。△8四飛と受ける手もあり、その場合は相手の飛車の動きに制約ができます。
explain.en: To protect the pawn on 3四 the opponent raised a gold, but this closes the opponent's bishop diagonal and pulls the gold away from the king's defense. The aim of tate-fu-tori is to induce △3三金 and spoil the opponent's formation. White can also defend with △8四飛, in which case the opponent's rook is restricted.

section.en: Toward a Tate Fu Dori formation

title.ja: 図3-3 端歩を突いてから角道を開ける
title.en: Figure 3-3: Push the edge pawn, then open the bishop diagonal

explain.ja: 端歩を突いてから角道を開けておきます。このタイミングでこちらの飛車の横利きが止まるので、△8六歩から飛車先を交換してくる手があります。
explain.en: Push the edge pawn and then open the bishop diagonal. At this moment our rook's sideways control is blocked, so the opponent may exchange the rook pawn starting with △8六歩.

section.ja: 端歩を突いてから角道を開ける
section.en: Push the edge pawn, then open the bishop diagonal

title.ja: 図3-4 飛車交換ならこちらが優勢
title.en: Figure 3-4: A rook exchange favors us

explain.ja: 相手が飛車先を交換してきたところで、こちらは▲7五歩と7筋の位を取ります。ここで相手が飛車交換してくれば、こちらだけ角道が開いている上、▲8二歩などの手もあるので、わずかに優勢になります。飛車交換の乱戦が嫌なら、▲7五歩の代わりに▲8七歩と打って安全に駒組みしてもよいでしょう。
explain.en: When the opponent exchanges the rook pawn, take the 7th-file position with ▲7五歩. If the opponent then exchanges rooks, only Black has the bishop diagonal open and moves such as ▲8二歩 are available, so Black is slightly better. If you dislike the melee of a rook exchange, dropping ▲8七歩 instead of ▲7五歩 lets you develop safely.

title.ja: 図3-5 △8七歩には▲9七角で問題なし
title.en: Figure 3-5: Against △8七歩, ▲9七角 is no problem

explain.ja: 相手は飛車交換を避けて、飛車を引きました。ここでこちらは▲7七桂と跳ねておきます。△8七歩と打たれても、▲9七角と受ければ問題ありません。
explain.en: The opponent avoided the rook exchange and retreated the rook. Black now jumps the knight to ▲7七桂. Even if White drops △8七歩, defending with ▲9七角 is fine.

section.ja: 桂跳ねから石田流の形に
section.en: Form Ishida-style shape from the knight jump

explain.ja: ▲8五歩と打って相手の飛車先を止めた後、三間飛車に振り直して石田流の形を作ります。
explain.en: After stopping the opponent's rook pawn with a ▲8五歩 drop, swing the rook again to Third File Rook and form the Ishida shape.

section.ja: 桂跳ねから石田流の形に
section.en: Form Ishida-style shape from the knight jump

title.ja: 図3-7 坊主美濃の囲い

explain.ja: 石田流の陣形が組めたら、美濃囲いに組むのが基本です。玉頭の歩がないため、この囲いは坊主美濃とも呼ばれます。
explain.en: Once the Ishida formation is built, building a Mino castle is the basic plan. Because there is no pawn at the king's head, this castle is also called Bōzu Mino (bald Mino).

section.ja: 桂跳ねから石田流の形に
section.en: Form Ishida-style shape from the knight jump

line.text: △6三銀、▲4八玉、△4二銀、▲3九玉、△9四歩、▲2八玉

title.ja: 図4-1 相手は角道を開けずに速攻
title.en: Figure 4-1: The opponent attacks quickly without opening the bishop diagonal

explain.ja: 図2-2に戻り、別の手順を見ます。今度は相手は角道を開けず、棒銀で速攻を狙ってきます。角道を開けてくれないと縦歩取りの形にはできません。
explain.en: Return to Diagram 2-2 and see another line. This time the opponent does not open the bishop diagonal and aims for a quick attack with Climbing Silver. If the opponent doesn't open the diagonal, the tate-fu-tori form cannot be made.

section.ja: 相手は角道を上げずに棒銀で速攻
section.en: The opponent does not raise the bishop and attacks quickly with Climbing Silver

explain.ja: こちらが角道を開けたタイミングで、相手は飛車先を交換してきました。その後は銀を進めてUFO銀の陣形に構えます。ここから棒銀で攻める狙いですが、どう受けるのでしょうか。
explain.en: When we opened the bishop diagonal, the opponent exchanged the rook pawn. Then it advanced the silver into the UFO silver formation, aiming to attack with Climbing Silver. How do we meet it?

section.ja: 相手は角道を上げずに棒銀で速攻
section.en: The opponent does not raise the bishop and attacks quickly with Climbing Silver

line.text: ▲7六歩、△8六歩、▲同歩、△同飛、▲8七歩、△8二飛、▲9六歩、△8三銀、▲3八銀、△7四銀

title.ja: 図4-3 桂跳ねで銀の進出をブロック
title.en: Figure 4-3: Block the silver's advance with a knight jump

explain.ja: ▲7七桂と桂馬を跳ねておけば、相手は銀を前に出せなくなります。これで棒銀を受けられます。
explain.en: If the knight is jumped to ▲7七桂, the opponent cannot bring the silver forward. That defends against Climbing Silver.

section.ja: 棒銀を桂跳ねで受ける
section.en: Defending Rushing Silver with a knight jump

title.ja: 図4-4 端角で銀を追い返す
title.en: Figure 4-4: Drive the silver back with an edge bishop

explain.ja: ▲9七角と端に角を使い、7筋の歩を突けば、相手の銀を追い返せます。
explain.en: Using the bishop on the edge with ▲9七角 and pushing the 7th-file pawn drives the opponent's silver back.

section.ja: 端角+▲7五歩で銀を追い返しつつ、石田流の形に
section.en: Edge bishop plus ▲7五歩 drives the silver back while forming Ishida

explain.ja: 銀を追い返した後、三間飛車に振り直せば石田流の陣形に組めます。ここからもやはり美濃囲いの陣形を目指します。
explain.en: After driving the silver back, swinging again to Third File Rook builds the Ishida formation. From here too, aim for a Mino castle.

section.ja: 端角+▲7五歩で銀を追い返しつつ、石田流の形に
section.en: Edge bishop plus ▲7五歩 drives the silver back while forming Ishida
